name: Remember That I Love You
objectiveText: Bring the Blood-Stained Letter to Orphan Matron Nightingale in Stormwind City. Blood-Stained Letter (Provided)  ( 1 )

comments.body:
The "Blood-Stained Letter" can be found in the Dungeon Ruins of Lordaeron at Undercity.
It is located at the Graveyard deep inside the dungeon at one of the bosses. 
After picking it up, bring it to Orphan Matron Nightingale infront of the Stormwind Cathedral.
She will send you to Darkshire in Duskwood where your gonna talk to Avette Fellwood, to give her the letter and turn in the 2nd quest.
